answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The spiral multiplier is published, charged in delta, and harbor lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4910 identities would post 3763 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
